summary: Two adults in an occupied RV swept about 100 yards down the San Juan River near Pagosa Springs were hoisted to safety by a Colorado National Guard helicopter after floodwaters stranded the vehicle around 2:30 a.m.; a swift-water team separately rescued a hypothermic elderly couple stranded across a flooded road the same morning; about 100 residents evacuated, with no deaths or serious injuries reported.
responding_agency: Archuleta County Sheriff's Office; Colorado National Guard
notes: San Juan River crested at 15.02 ft in Pagosa Springs Oct 23, second-highest on record (1911: 17.80 ft); disaster emergency covered 12 counties. Dog count in the RV conflicts across sources (2 per sheriff via Focal, 3 per AP account) — not counted in victims. Resolves the parked Oct 23 Pagosa flood watch from the 2026-10-25 freshness sweep, which waited on a sheriff/CPR follow-up.
